say:2:1321317001:1.text: Oh, you're the guests from earlier! Thank goodness. Please, you have to help me!
say:2:1321317001:1.source_cn: 你们是刚才的客人！太好了……请一定要帮帮我！

say:3:1321317002:1.text: Calm down. Take a deep breath and tell us what's going on.
say:3:1321317002:1.source_cn: 别着急，慢慢说，究竟发生了什么事？

say:4:1321317003:1.source_cn: 是野狼！这附近有野狼出没！

say:5:1321317004:1.text: I was leading the reindeer to deliver goods to the Frozen Paw, and a pack of wolves appeared out of nowhere!
say:5:1321317004:1.source_cn: 我领着驯鹿往白熊旅店运货，原本好好走在路上……可没想到...

say:6:1321317005:1.text: The reindeer panicked and kicked at the wolves, which gave me a chance to escape. I tried to make it to the inn, but I hurt my leg and can barely move...
say:6:1321317005:1.source_cn: 驯鹿受到惊吓，踹了那些野狼好几脚，我这才趁机逃了出来。...

say:7:1321317006:1.text: I didn't know what to do until I saw you. Please, drive off those wolves and save the reindeer! If anything happens to it or the goods, Varon will never forgive me!
say:7:1321317006:1.source_cn: ——幸好遇到了你们！求求你们，帮我赶走那些野狼，救救驯...

say:10:1321317007:1.text: Where's the reindeer and the wolves now?

say:11:1321317008:1.text: You'll see them if you <style="highlight">head north along the path</style>. Oh, Dura above, please keep the reindeer safe!
